searchText: I responded with some of my thoughts: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/231#issuecomment-739720482 You make a very good point that I failed to consider that RLP Envelope and Custom RLP Encoding both have discrimination problems! I think for me that puts me strongly against both of them. Leaving the two you picked out as your choices as the only "viable" options. I still favor opaque bytes personally. decisions from the call: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/231#issuecomment-739998185 Can you add that last note to your summary <@543900561460822016>? The thing about "MUST NOT propagate typed transactions prior to fork block". will do
